parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Monokpo-street (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1426 | 2.2 | 2.2
2 | 569 | 0.998 | 3.2
3 | 1241 | 23.2 | 26.4
4 | 1931 | 30.1 | 56.5
5 | 2994 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HAA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Monokpo-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HAA
Aquifer depth: 26.4 – 56.5 m (Layer 4, high-resistivity sand unit; Layer 5 below 56.5 m may represent a deeper, thicker aquiferous zone)
Recommendation: Target drilling and screen placement within the 26.4–56.5 m interval, which corresponds to the resistive sandy aquifer; confirm continuity of high resistivity below 56.5 m during drilling as it may indicate an additional deeper productive zone worth screening.
